citation.title: Effects of intermittent hypoxia-hyperoxia vs hypoxia-normoxia vs sustained normoxia on psycho-physiological responses during submaximal constant-load cycling (normoxia arm entered)

population.description: Fifteen physically active healthy males aged 20 to 39 years (enrolment range, not observed min/max); body weight 80.3 +/- 9.6 kg; VO2peak 51.4 +/- 6.5 mL/min/kg. Heart-rate findings carry n 14 (Table 3 ANOVA dfs F20,260 and F2,26 imply 14); the paper reports no exclusion.

protocols.name: nor_cycling_60pct
protocols.description: Sustained-normoxia (NOR) trial only: 5-min warm-up at 40% VO2peak (minutes 0-5) and 40 min of cycling at 60% VO2peak, 80 rpm (minutes 5-45), then rest to 10 min after exercise (minute 55); duration 56 minutes (states 0 to 55). The paper says 'thereafter', so the bout is taken to follow the warm-up directly. Group VO2peak 51.4 mL/min/kg (Methods, participants). Bout: 0.60 x 51.4 = 30.84 mL/kg/min; level = (30.84 - 3.7)/31.7 = 0.856. Warm-up: 0.40 x 51.4 = 20.56 mL/kg/min; level = (20.56 - 3.7)/31.7 = 0.532. Last meal at least 2 h before each visit (no composition given; no drink during the bout stated), so no meal is entered and the arm is started from typical values. Time of day only 'a similar time of the day' across trials, so start hour assumed 10.0. Heart-rate period P4..P40 is the 4-min period of the bout that ends at that bout minute (Table 3: 'averaged over every 4-min period during exercise'), so P4 is bout minutes 0-4, i.e. arm minutes 5-9. Post 0 is taken as the first minute after the bout (minute 45) and Post 10 as minute 55.
